public_book_definition.archived_public_book_definition: Archived public Predict market order-book snapshots reconstructed from source checkpoints and deltas, ordered by source_ms then received_ms; no private account/order fields are published.
public_book_definition.side_level_schema: [price, quantity] pairs, best-first, up to five actual levels per side; no fabricated padding
public_book_definition.public_export_causal_availability_rule: max(received_ms, chain_received_max_ms); source_ms is the source event timestamp, not arrival availability.
public_book_definition.strict_classifier_source_tape: R2 base/inputs/tapes/<market_id>.json.xz; update u[0]=source_ms, u[1]=received_ms, u[6] carries bids/asks deltas; full checkpoint and per-price deltas are applied to a book before quotes.
public_book_definition.strict_classifier_event_order: sort by (received_ms, source_ms); received_ms defines strict-past availability and source_ms breaks ties. This classifier does not use chain_received_max_ms from the separate public JSON export.
public_book_definition.full_L2_replay_feed: paired events.npz uses full captured L2 depth updates, with receipt-aligned event clocks; separate from top-five-per-side public JSON view.

method.favourite_snapshot: latest valid book received at or before official window start + 12,000 ms (bisect_right; cutoff inclusive); no valid snapshot gives UNKNOWN.
method.flip_interval: 12,000 ms <= received_ms - window_start_ms < 290,000 ms; favourite-relative mid <= 0.40 (inclusive).
method.winner_use: classification only, after book F and flip checks; it assigns offline true/false/no-flip categories. No label value is passed to the strategy process.
method.coverage_and_selection: coverage warning is recorded but not used as a filter; all 861 fixed IDs are included. No quality, trade-count or outcome deletion/replacement.

r1_to_r2.differences_summary: R2 only changes worker failure continuation/status; job name and job_id prefixes; protocol declaration; source-parent note; actor_contract baseline package path. Strategy, runtime files, strict predicate, jobs other than name prefix, and all 861 inputs are unchanged.

runtime_hash_boundary.scope_note: R1/R2 bundle contains the same 44 runtime files; two are raw installer inputs in the staged bundle and differ from final RUNTIME_HASHES pins. The separate recorded sizing smoke confirms the two pre/post hash pairs; this audit did not install or execute them.

r2_independent_cell_control.source_change: if a cell fails, preserve its output directory, mark it invalid, continue launching remaining fixed cells once; no retry or replacement; overall worker status COMPLETE_WITH_INVALID_PATHS and rc 2 if any invalid path.
r2_independent_cell_control.R2_stage_unsubmitted_status: parent-reported at assignment; no worker/result inspected in this audit

completion_and_economic_gate_static_cont.return_code_contract: rc0 requires all eight exact boolean gates true; rc2 is accepted only when the legacy active_matches_opportunity gate is false, all other seven gate values except pass are true, and pass is false.
additional_path_requirements: no clock capture error and invalid is false
full_analyzer_source_conditions: each arm expected cohort is len(INPUTS[ETH]) == 861
every expected job must be present with a result and completion_errors must return empty
per-path receipt accounting reconciles to raw/native inventory/cost/trading_volume/trades; receipt sequence strictly increases
native module actual_sha == expected_sha == frozen pin
engine settings must match the job queue/latency/tick/lot/fees/exchange and events_sha256 input pin
new/cancel action counts equal raw submit/cancel counts; frame plans are ordered and count matches source frames
gate PASS only when execution_valid == 861, valued == 861, all three classes NO_FLIP/FALSE_FLIP/TRUE_FLIP are present, UNKNOWN class absent, EACH condition true and bootstrap lower CI > 0
completion_and_economic_gate_static_cont.current_frozen_label_class_input_gate: UNKNOWN_LABEL_OR_CLASSIFICATION is forced for a fully executed cohort with the current 860 unique binary labels plus one nonbinary label and four UNKNOWN classifications; no economic gate result was evaluated.
completion_and_economic_gate_static_cont.official_winner_location: winner is carried in coordinator JOBS/INPUTS metadata and is used by offline classifier/analyzer only. Worker EXECUTION.json records full job metadata; worker command/env passes market, queue, latency and env_v12 only; no sensitive winner/target/oracle/direction keys are present in env_v12; single_path.py sets --mode NO_DIRECTION.
completion_and_economic_gate_static_cont.post_window_action_treatment: full analyzer counts post-window NEW/CANCEL actions and exchange/receive-time fills for reporting; static source does not reject a path solely because these counts are nonzero. Actual counts were not inspected.

copied_analyzers.static_assessment: stage analyze.py is per-path synthetic/parity acceptance, not the 861 fixed-cohort economics analyzer. Stage analyze_cg1at_fresh100a.py is a copied legacy 200-path analyzer requiring proto.markets; ETH PROTOCOL has 861 markets and no markets field. Neither copied file was run or used to evaluate ETH economics. Task-root analyze_full.py is the applicable full-cohort source.

source_literal_scan.scope: all Python files under R6, ETH v1r1, ETH v1r2 stage roots/base/overlay/runtime

limitations: No native/worker/replay or ETH full analyzer was executed by this audit; no PnL, fills, receipt traces, worker return files, or database records were read.
R2 remains static/unsubmitted per parent assignment; post-run output validity, order lifecycle, and actual post-window action counts remain unverified.
The four UNKNOWN rows remain in the fixed cohort; no replacement, quality exclusion, or outcome-based sample selection was applied.
Public trade archive completeness remains UNKNOWN for all 861 markets.
